requires.reason: The scenario catalogue pairs each scenario with an EN 16931 VAT category and exemption reason code

regime.name: EU VAT scenarios (VAT Directive 2006/112/EC) as expressed in the core
regime.note: A thin package (18, Q10): the two tax classes that country packages need, and the scenario catalogue of 08, section 3 with the derived EU keys of ADR-200 and the EN 16931 pairing. The actual codes, rates, boxes and rules of a country are in its country package. EU membership by date is a platform table (07, 4), not package content

owner: Platform team (provisional: the platform team owns the regime package until a VAT community of practice takes it, 18, Q4)
scope: Tax classes GOODS and SERVICES. Scenario catalogue (documentation, app content). Not in this package: country VAT codes, rates and boxes, OSS and IOSS return structures (they are rows keyed by country and rate, 08, 6.1), customs
